DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座のお申込みについてですね。どのようにお使いになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol sa pag-aaplay ng account, tama? Para saan ninyo balak gamitin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい勤務先から給与を受け取るためです。初めてこの銀行に申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初回申込みで給与受取用の口座を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Para tumanggap ng sahod mula sa bago kong trabaho. Unang beses kong mag-aaplay sa bangkong ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing unang aplikasyon ito at gusto ng account para sa sahod. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先から、支店や口座の種類について指定はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: May itinakda ba ang trabaho tungkol sa sangay o uri ng account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 銀行名だけ指定されています。この給与の案内に書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先の銀行指定の範囲を説明し案内を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Pangalan lang ng bangko ang itinakda. Nakasulat dito sa gabay sa sahod.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag kung ano ang itinakda ng trabaho sa bangko at ipakita ang gabay. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拝見します。本人確認の書類には、今の住所が載っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titingnan ko. Nasa mga dokumento ng pagkakakilanlan ba ang kasalukuyang tirahan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードの裏に新しい住所があります。先週、住所を変えました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在留カードの現住所と住所変更時期を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nasa likod ng residence card ang bagong tirahan. Nagpalit ako ng address noong nakaraang linggo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang kasalukuyang address sa residence card at kailan ito binago. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの確認事項も含めて担当者が書類を拝見します。給与日はいつですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Susuriin ng kawaning namamahala ang mga dokumento pati ibang kailangang tiyakin. Kailan ang sahod?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今月の二十五日です。それまでに開設できなかった場合、勤務先へ何と伝えればよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 給与日を伝え開設が間に合わない場合の勤務先への説明を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Sa ikadalawampu't lima ngayong buwan. Kung hindi mabubuksan bago noon, ano ang dapat sabihin sa trabaho?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang araw ng sahod at itanong ang sasabihin sa trabaho kung hindi aabot ang pagbubukas. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 開設時期はここではお約束できません。申込み中であることを伝えて、給与の受け取り方を勤務先に相談してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Hindi namin maipapangako rito kung kailan mabubuksan. Sabihing kasalukuyang nag-aaplay at kausapin ang trabaho tungkol sa pagtanggap ng sahod.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。今日は申込みの説明を聞いて、必要な書類をそろえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 申込みの説明を聞いて書類をそろえると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naintindihan ko. Ngayon ay pakikinggan ko ang paliwanag sa aplikasyon at kukumpletuhin ang kailangang dokumento.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing pakikinggan ang paliwanag sa aplikasyon at ihahanda ang mga dokumento. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは担当者へおつなぎします。本日はありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Kung gayon, iuugnay ko kayo sa kawaning namamahala. Salamat sa pagpunta ngayon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 米の値札をお探しですか。どの袋でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hinahanap ninyo ang presyo ng bigas? Aling supot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この緑の袋です。下に二枚値札があるので、どちらの値段かわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 緑の米袋に対応する値札がわからないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Itong berde. May dalawang etiketa sa ilalim kaya hindi ko alam kung aling presyo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing hindi alam kung aling etiketa ng presyo ang para sa berdeng supot ng bigas. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 緑の二キロ袋は千二百八十円です。隣の千九百八十円は、白い五キロ袋の値札です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Ang berdeng dalawang kilo ay 1,280 yen. Ang katabing 1,980 yen ay etiketa para sa puting limang kilo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 緑は二キロで千二百八十円ですね。会員価格と書いてある札は何の分ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 容量と価格を確認し会員価格の対象を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kaya berde, dalawang kilo sa 1,280 yen. Para saan ang etiketa ng presyong pangmiyembro?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang timbang at presyo at itanong kung para saan ang presyong pangmiyembro. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 白い五キロ袋の会員価格です。緑の袋は会員でなくても同じ値段です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Iyon ay presyong pangmiyembro ng puting limang kilo. Ang berde ay pareho ang presyo kahit hindi miyembro.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人暮らしなので緑にします。この袋に持ち手はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二キロ袋を選び持ち手の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Mag-isa lang ako sa bahay kaya berde ang kukunin ko. May hawakan ba itong supot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Piliin ang dalawang kilo at itanong kung may hawakan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 持ち手はありません。持ち帰り用の有料の袋はレジで買えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Wala. Makakabili sa kahera ng bag na may bayad para maiuwi ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 買い物袋を持ってきました。この大きさなら米の袋が入りそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参した買い物袋に米が入るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: May dala akong shopping bag. Kasya kaya ang supot ng bigas sa ganitong laki?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Itanong kung kasya ang bigas sa dalang shopping bag. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、横に寝かせれば入る大きさです。持ち上げるときは、底にも手を添えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo, kasya kung ihihiga nang pahalang. Kapag bubuhatin, alalayan din ng kamay ang ilalim.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、この二キロを横に入れて持ち帰ります。値札の説明もありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 米を横に入れて持ち帰ると伝え説明への礼を言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Kung gayon, ilalagay ko itong dalawang kilo nang pahalang at iuuwi. Salamat din sa paliwanag sa mga presyo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing iuuwi ang bigas nang nakahiga sa bag at magpasalamat sa paliwanag. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お会計はあちらのレジでどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Salamat. Sa kahera roon po ang bayad.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。散歩道のご案内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Magandang araw. Kailangan ninyo ng gabay sa lakaran?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三十分ほど歩いて、この入口に戻りたいです。途中で座れる道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三十分程度で入口へ戻り途中で座れる道を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto kong maglakad nang mga tatlumpung minuto at bumalik sa pasukang ito. May rutang may mauupuan sa daan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng rutang babalik sa pasukan sa mga tatlumpung minuto at may mauupuan sa daan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 池の手前まで行って花壇沿いに戻る道なら、ゆっくり歩いて二十分ほどです。花壇の横にベンチがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kung hanggang bago ang lawa at babalik sa tabi ng taniman ng bulaklak, mga dalawampung minuto sa mabagal na lakad. May bangko sa tabi ng mga bulaklak.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 池を一周する道とは違うのですね。階段は通りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池一周との違いと階段の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Iba iyon sa rutang umiikot sa lawa, tama? Dadaan ba sa hagdan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong ang kaibhan sa pag-ikot sa lawa at kung may hagdan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 一周する道には階段がありますが、花壇沿いの道にはありません。小さな橋の手前で右へ曲がってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: May hagdan sa rutang paikot sa lawa, pero wala sa tabi ng mga bulaklak. Lumiko pakanan bago ang maliit na tulay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 橋は渡らず、手前で右ですね。ベンチは日陰にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 橋の前で曲がると確認しベンチの日陰を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi tatawid, kundi pakanan bago ang tulay. Nasa lilim ba ang bangko?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyaking liliko bago ang tulay at itanong kung malilim ang bangko. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きな木の下にあります。そこからこの入口の時計が見えますよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Nasa ilalim ng malaking puno. Mula roon ay makikita ang orasan sa pasukang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時計が見えるなら戻りやすそうです。花壇までの道は、砂利ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時計を目印にできると伝え路面を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kung makikita ang orasan, mukhang madaling makabalik. Graba ba ang daan hanggang sa mga bulaklak?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing maaaring gawing palatandaan ang orasan at itanong ang ibabaw ng daan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 池までは舗装されています。花壇の横だけ砂利なので、足元にお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: May matigas na sapin ang daan hanggang sa lawa. Sa tabi lang ng mga bulaklak ang graba, kaya ingatan ang hakbang.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。花壇のベンチで休んで、時計を目印に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休憩場所と入口へ戻る目印を言い直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naintindihan ko. Magpapahinga ako sa bangko sa tabi ng mga bulaklak at babalik gamit ang orasan bilang palatandaan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ulitin ang pahingahan at palatandaan pabalik sa pasukan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29202-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ、ゆっくりお楽しみください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお困りですか。改札はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: May problema ba? Dito ang tarangkahan ng tiket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が西口で待っています。私は東口にいるのですが、反対側へ行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の待つ出口への行き方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Naghihintay ang kaibigan ko sa kanlurang labasan. Nasa silangang labasan ako, makakapunta ba sa kabilang panig?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong ang daan sa labasang hinihintayan ng kaibigan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 改札には入らず、外の地下通路をお使いください。階段を下りて、向こう側で上がります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Huwag pumasok sa tarangkahan ng tiket; gamitin ang lagusan sa ilalim ng lupa sa labas nito. Bumaba sa hagdan at umakyat sa kabila.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 大きなスーツケースがあるのですが、エレベーターはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 荷物の事情を伝えエレベーターを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: May malaki akong maleta. May elevator ba?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang bagahe at itanong ang elevator. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 地下通路にはありません。こちら側なら、駅前の時計の下で待ち合わせができます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Wala sa lagusan. Sa panig na ito, puwedeng magkita sa ilalim ng orasan sa harap ng istasyon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、友人にこちらへ来てもらいます。時計はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 待ち合わせ場所を変更し時計の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kung gayon, papupuntahin ko rito ang kaibigan ko. Nasaan ang orasan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Baguhin ang tagpuan at itanong ang lokasyon ng orasan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 東口を出て左です。屋根の下に、丸い時計が掛かっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Paglabas sa silangang labasan, sa kaliwa. May bilog na orasan na nakasabit sa ilalim ng bubong.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出口を出て左ですね。そこにベンチもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出口の方向を確認しベンチを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Kaliwa paglabas, tama? May bangko rin ba roon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang direksiyon mula sa labasan at itanong ang bangko. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時計の向かいにあります。通行の邪魔にならないよう、荷物はベンチの横へ寄せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Nasa tapat ng orasan. Itabi ang bagahe sa gilid ng bangko para hindi makaharang sa dumaraan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。時計の写真を送って、ベンチで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合流のための連絡と待つ場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Magpapadala ako ng litrato ng orasan at maghihintay sa bangko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pakikipag-ugnayan para magkita at kung saan maghihintay. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、お連れ様と合流できるといいですね。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sana magkita kayo ng kasama ninyo. Ingat po.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 申請書をお預かりします。住所はこちらでお間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tatanggapin ko ang aplikasyon. Tama ba ang address na ito?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません、前に住んでいた住所を書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 申請書に旧住所を書いたことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Pasensiya, nailagay ko ang dati kong tirahan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihing nailagay ang lumang address sa aplikasyon. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の住所に直していただけますか。書き直し用の用紙もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Maaari bang itama sa kasalukuyang address? May bagong papel din kung magsusulat muli.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 氏名などは書けているので、この用紙で訂正したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ用紙で訂正したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Naisulat ko na ang pangalan at iba pa, kaya gusto kong itama sa papel na ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihing gustong itama sa parehong papel. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、間違った住所に二重線を引いて、下の余白に今の住所をお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kung gayon, guhitan nang dalawang linya ang maling address at isulat ang kasalukuyan sa bakante sa ibaba.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここに部屋番号まで書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 部屋番号の記入場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dito ko ba isusulat pati numero ng kuwarto?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin kung saan isusulat ang numero ng kuwarto. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、建物名と部屋番号もお願いします。証明書は何通必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo, pati pangalan ng gusali at numero ng kuwarto. Ilang kopya ng sertipiko ang kailangan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一通です。部屋番号は二〇三で、今の住所を書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な通数と訂正した住所の情報を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Isa. 203 ang numero ng kuwarto, at naisulat ko na ang kasalukuyang address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kailangang dami ng kopya at impormasyon sa itinamang address. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。本人確認の書類を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Salamat. Maaari bang makita ang dokumento ng pagkakakilanlan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、こちらの在留カードです。住所の欄も更新されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人確認書類を提示し住所更新を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Oo, ito ang residence card. Na-update na rin ang bahagi ng address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang dokumento ng pagkakakilanlan at sabihing na-update ang address. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 拝見しますね。確認が済みましたら番号をお呼びしますので、お掛けになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titingnan ko. Tatawagin ang numero kapag tapos nang suriin, kaya maupo at maghintay.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察の前に、お困りの症状を伺います。どこが痛みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Bago ang konsultasyon, itatanong ko ang inyong mga sintomas. Saan masakit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の手首です。昨日から、物を持ち上げると痛みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 痛む部位と始まった時期を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa kanang pulsuhan. Mula kahapon, masakit kapag nagbubuhat ng bagay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang masakit na bahagi at kung kailan nagsimula. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転んだり、どこかにぶつけたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nadapa ba kayo o naibangga ito sa kung saan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、ぶつけていません。仕事で箱を何度も持ち上げました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外傷の有無と手首を使った作業を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi, hindi ko naibangga. Paulit-ulit akong nagbuhat ng kahon sa trabaho.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin kung may pinsala at ang gawaing gumamit ng pulsuhan. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのことも医師に伝えます。今、じっとしていても痛みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sasabihin ko rin iyon sa doktor. Masakit ba ngayon kahit hindi ginagalaw?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 動かさなければあまり痛くありません。仕事を休む必要があるか、診察で聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 安静時の状態と医師に聞きたいことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi gaanong masakit kung hindi ginagalaw. Gusto kong itanong sa pagsusuri kung kailangang lumiban sa trabaho.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ilarawan ang kalagayan kapag nakapahinga at ang gustong itanong sa doktor. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: わかりました。仕事の内容と、休む必要があるか知りたいことを申し送りします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Naintindihan ko. Ipapasa ko ang nilalaman ng trabaho at ang tanong kung kailangan ninyong lumiban.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 説明を聞くとき、メモを取ってもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 診察でメモを取る許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Puwede ba akong magtala habang nakikinig sa paliwanag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Humingi ng pahintulot na magtala sa konsultasyon. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。聞き取れなかったら、医師にもう一度説明してほしいとお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. Kung hindi marinig o maunawaan ang sinabi, hilingin sa doktor na ipaliwanag muli.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。箱の重さも、忘れないようにメモしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 医師に伝える作業の情報を記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Salamat. Itatala ko rin ang bigat ng mga kahon para hindi makalimutan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing itatala ang impormasyon sa gawain na sasabihin sa doktor. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お名前をお呼びするまで、こちらでお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Maghintay dito hanggang tawagin ang pangalan. Pagaling po.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どうされましたか。こちらへお掛けください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 朝置いた自転車が、帰りに見つかりませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車が見つからないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Hindi ko nakita pagbalik ang bisikletang iniwan ko noong umaga.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humingi ng tulong dahil hindi makita ang bisikleta. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこに止めて、何時ごろ戻られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Saan ipinarada at anong oras bumalik?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅の北側の駐輪場です。八時に止めて、五時に戻りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 駐輪した場所と時間帯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sa paradahan ng bisikleta sa hilaga ng istasyon. Iniwan ko nang alas-otso at bumalik nang alas-singko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang lugar at oras ng pagkakaparada. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 車体の色や、目印になる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ano ang kulay at may palatandaan ba?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀色で、前のかごに青いひもを結んでいます。写真もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色と目印を伝え写真があると知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pilak, at may asul na tali sa basket sa harap. May litrato rin ako.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang kulay at palatandaan at na may litrato. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を見せてください。鍵は掛けていましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 後ろの車輪の鍵を掛けました。防犯登録の控えは家にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 施錠と防犯登録控えの所在を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ikinandado ko ang gulong sa likod. Nasa bahay ang kopya ng rehistrasyong laban sa pagnanakaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang pagkakakandado at lokasyon ng kopya ng rehistro. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 控えの番号も調べる手がかりになります。駐輪場の撤去案内はご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Makakatulong din sa pagsisiyasat ang numero sa kopya. Nakita ba ang abiso ng pag-alis ng bisikleta sa paradahan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ見ていません。控えを持ってきて、撤去案内の写真も見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えと撤去案内を用意する予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Hindi pa. Dadalhin ko ang kopya at ipapakita rin ang litrato ng abiso ng pag-alis.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang planong ihanda ang kopya at abiso ng pag-alis. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。戻られたら、こちらの窓口でお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naintindihan ko. Pagbalik, kausapin kami sa tanggapang ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この箱をお送りですね。宛名のラベルを見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Ipapadala ninyo ang kahong ito, tama? Maaari bang makita ang etiketa ng tatanggap?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、家で印刷しました。文字が薄いのですが、このまま使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薄い宛名ラベルを使用できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo, inilimbag ko sa bahay. Maputla ang mga letra, magagamit ba nang ganito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung magagamit ang maputlang etiketa ng tatanggap. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住所の一部が読み取りにくいので、こちらのラベルに書き直していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Mahirap basahin ang bahagi ng address, kaya maaari bang isulat muli sa etiketang ito?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: わかりました。送り先は携帯電話に入っていますが、それを見ながら書いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 携帯電話の住所を見ながら記入してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Naintindihan ko. Nasa cellphone ang address ng padadalhan, puwede bang isulat habang tinitingnan iyon?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itanong kung puwedeng sumulat habang tinitingnan ang address sa cellphone. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。郵便番号と住所、お名前を順にお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Oo. Isulat ang postal code, address, at pangalan sa pagkakasunod na iyan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住所が長いので、この二段を使っても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 長い住所の記入欄を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Mahaba ang address, puwede bang gamitin ang dalawang linyang ito?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang puwang para sa mahabang address. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大丈夫です。建物名と部屋番号も省かずにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Puwede. Huwag alisin ang pangalan ng gusali at numero ng kuwarto.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書けました。送り主の欄には、自分の住所を書きますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送り主欄に自分の住所を記入すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Naisulat ko na. Ilalagay ko ang sarili kong address sa bahagi ng nagpapadala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing ilalagay ang sariling address sa bahagi ng nagpapadala. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。書き終わったら、印刷した古いラベルはこちらで外します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Oo. Pagkatapos sumulat, kami ang mag-aalis dito ng lumang inilimbag na etiketa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しいラベルを書き終えました。古いほうを外してから、これを貼ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新ラベルの完成を伝え貼り替えを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tapos na ang bagong etiketa. Alisin muna ang luma bago idikit ito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihing tapos na ang bagong etiketa at humiling ng pagpapalit. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらで受付を進めます。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Kung gayon, itutuloy namin ang pagtanggap. Salamat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol ba sa passbook ang tanong?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、記帳機に入れたら、そのまま戻ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 記帳機から通帳が返されたことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oo, pagpasok ko sa makinang nagpi-print ng passbook, ibinalik lang agad.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na ibinalik ng makina ang passbook. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 画面には何と表示されていましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい通帳が必要、と出ていました。最後のページまで使っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 画面の表示と通帳の使用状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nakalagay na kailangan ng bagong passbook. Nagamit na hanggang huling pahina.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang nasa screen at kalagayan ng paggamit sa passbook. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 記入欄がいっぱいですね。窓口で新しい通帳へ繰り越しますので、お預かりしてよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Puno na ang mga puwang. Ililipat namin sa bagong passbook sa counter, maaari bang kunin ko?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。古い通帳も返してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 繰り越しを依頼し旧通帳の返却を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Sige po. Ibabalik din ba ang lumang passbook?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilinging ilipat sa bago at itanong kung ibabalik ang luma. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、繰り越し後に両方お返しします。古い通帳に挟んでいる紙は、お取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Oo, ibabalik pareho pagkatapos. Pakikuha ang papel na nakasingit sa lumang passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この家賃のメモですね。外しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 挟んだメモを外すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Itong tala sa upa, tama? Aalisin ko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing aalisin ang nakasingit na tala. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。新しい通帳の表紙のお名前も、ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Salamat. Pakitingnan din ang pangalan sa pabalat ng bagong passbook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前は合っています。これからは新しいほうを記帳機に入れますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表紙の名前と使う通帳を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Tama ang pangalan. Mula ngayon, ang bago na ang ipapasok ko sa makina.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang pangalan sa pabalat at passbook na gagamitin. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらをお使いください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Oo, ito ang gamitin. Salamat sa pagpunta.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのトマト、一つ皮が破れています。別のパックをお持ちしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Punit ang balat ng isang kamatis dito. Kukuha ba ako ng ibang pakete?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。小さいトマトが六つ入った物がいいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 交換を依頼し欲しいパックを指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sige po. Gusto ko ang may anim na maliliit na kamatis.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Humiling ng kapalit at tukuyin ang gustong pakete. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ六個入りをお持ちします。ほかの商品を先に読み取ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kukuha ako ng kaparehong anim ang laman. Puwede bang i-scan muna ang ibang bilihin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、お願いします。卵は最後に袋へ入れたいので、横に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会計を進めることを了承し卵の置き方を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Oo, sige. Gusto kong huling ilagay sa bag ang mga itlog, kaya itabi muna.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Pumayag na ituloy ang pagbabayad at hilinging itabi ang mga itlog. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 卵はこちらへ置きますね。新しいトマトが届きましたので、ご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Dito ko ilalagay ang itlog. Dumating na ang bagong kamatis, pakitingnan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今度は傷がありません。同じ値段ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 交換品を確認し値段を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Wala nang sira ngayon. Pareho ba ang presyo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Suriin ang kapalit at itanong ang presyo. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、二百九十八円です。全部で千二百四十円になります。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 千円札と、二百四十円を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現金で支払う額を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Magbibigay ako ng isang libong yen na papel at 240 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang halagang ibabayad sa cash. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ちょうどお預かりしました。袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Sakto ang natanggap. May bag ba kayo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この袋を使います。卵を上に載せて持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持参袋と卵の入れ方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Itong bag ang gagamitin ko. Ilalagay ko sa ibabaw ang mga itlog para iuwi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang dalang bag at paraan ng paglalagay ng itlog. Sabihin ito sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-29203-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: レシートはこちらです。ありがとうございました。
